title: Angels of Death
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Thirteen-year-old Rachel "Ray" Gardner wakes with no memory in the basement of a building where each floor is ruled by a killer. She strikes a pact with the bandaged serial killer Zack: she will help him escape, and he will then kill her as she wishes. Climbing the floors, they learn that a reverend, Gray, built the game to test religious faith, and that Ray killed her father after he killed her mother (Wikipedia game article, which covers the manga adaptation; Yen Press blurb).
life_message: Even broken people who have done terrible things can find a reason to keep living through an unlikely bond.
